verdict.rationale: Milvus is API-first. Every documented capability is reached through the `MilvusClient` SDK, including local and standalone setup, search, full-text, multi-vector and filtered search, CRUD, multi-tenancy and RBAC. The same client code runs across Lite, Standalone and Distributed, and an official MCP server exposes collection management and search to agents. missing for 10: any explicit statement of API/UI feature parity or mention of a UI to compare against, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of admin-level operations via API.
